reviews.text: Uniswap is the leading decentralized exchange on Ethereum, using the AMM model for permissionless trading. Launched in 2018, it has versions V3 and V4 with concentrated liquidity. In 2025, it’s multi-chain with billions in TVL. Governance is community-led via the UNI token. It’s essential for DeFi, but gas fees can be high.

Uniswap was the first decentralized exchange on Ethereum, it is using automated market maker (AMM) pools. It is the largest DEX by volume and liquidity. Traders often say Uniswap is the Amazon of Ethereum DEXs. In 2025 it launched v4, introducing “Hooks” (programmable liquidity pools). The protocol’s core is fully tested, secure and continuously updated, as a proof of its capability Q3 2025 saw Uniswap’s trading volume near $300B. Its UNI token governs the platform but at the moment captures no fees. Beyond its core DEX, Uniswap Labs launched UniswapX in 2025, a hybrid aggregator for optimal trading execution. It combines automated market making with off-chain orders to minimize MEV and slippage.

Uniswap is a decentralized exchange that uses automated market making primarily built on Ethereum but later expanded to layer 2s and other layer 1 EVM compatible block chains. Since its launch in 2018, Uniswap has transformed from the first version the current most recent V4 version that supports Hooks, an external smart contract that allows Dex limit order and TP/SL features that were only found on centralized exchanges. Uniswap was founded by an experienced team supported by top tier VCs like a16z, Paradigm and Polychain Capital. In terms of security, Uniswap has multiple third party audits and a lucrative active bug bounty program in order to protect users' funds.

Uniswap has long been the gold standard for a trustless DEX in my book. It’s by far the most used AMM anyone can swap or add liquidity instantly without KYC. I often use it because it’s always reliable. The catch is that even Uniswap has risks: as a smart contract platform, it’s not immune to bugs or front running, and its more complex features can confuse newbies. So while it’s rock solid, it still requires care.

Uniswap is basically the backbone of DEX trading on Ethereum. It’s simple, smooth, and has proven itself over years. The protocol feels reliable, and most new tokens still use Uniswap as their first home. Even with all the new DEX competitors, Uniswap still stands out because of its history, liquidity, and consistency. It’s not perfect, but it’s one of the few crypto projects that actually earned its reputation.
